rationale: The Guion example closely matches the new task: it validates signed JSON payloads, stores event state in SQLite, retries delivery, tracks dead letters, and reports status and failures. Both languages passed the acceptance cases, while Guion’s frozen-case median was 0.144 seconds versus Python’s 0.818 seconds. That performance advantage supports choosing Guion for this similar workload.
trial_observation: The requested command completed successfully: Guion and Python each passed all 9 cases. The seven-pair timing medians include process and oracle-check time, so they are evidence about this frozen case rather than a standalone runtime benchmark.
